title: Homogeneous ideals with minimal singularity thresholds
summary: Let $(\mathcal{O}_n, \mathfrak{m})$ denote the ring of germs of holomorphic functions $\mathbb{C}^n\to \mathbb{C}$, and let $I\subseteq \mathcal{O}_n$ be an $\mathfrak{m}$-primary ideal. Demailly and Pham showed that $\mathrm{lct}(I) \geq \frac{1}{e_1(I)} + \dots + \frac{e_{n-1}(I)}{e_n(I)}$, where $e_j(I)$ is the mixed multiplicity $e(I,\dots, I, \mathfrak{m},\dots, \mathfrak{m})$, with $I$ repeated $j$ times and $\mathfrak{m}$ repeated $n-j$ times.
